scope: TLS termination check: a self-signed certificate, deploy/console-tls-proxy.ts terminating HTTPS in front of a stub upstream that serves the real built console page, HTTP to HTTPS redirection, the transport security headers, and the proxy's own refusals. Not a public certificate, not a running installation, not the operator's chosen proxy (nginx, Caddy, the platform proxy).

checks.check: stub upstream serving the real built page
proxy binds the HTTPS and the redirect port it was given
the built page is served over HTTPS unchanged
HTTPS carries the transport security header
an asset is served over HTTPS byte for byte
a management route is reachable through the proxy
the proxy tells the upstream the original protocol was https
plain HTTP is redirected to HTTPS
a group or world readable key is refused
a missing certificate argument is refused
the proxy shut down on SIGTERM
both ports are released after shutdown
